items.title: Moves are back
items.body: Exercise animations play again on every exercise, smooth at 60 fps.

items.title: Film my workout
items.body: Show the weight, lift, and MonkeyFit names the move, counts reps, checks form and logs it. Video never leaves your iPhone.

items.title: Climb on a gym day
items.body: Tap Climb on the day to track it live or log it.
